newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Lenenergo power company a buy - Pioneer.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Lenenergo power company a buy - Pioneer.

text.p: Russian regional power utility Lenenergo could benefit from current reforms in the electricity sector, a research report by Pioneer Securities said on Thursday. The report rated the company as a buy.

The report said the utility, the biggest integrated power company in Russia's northwestern region with 36 operating units, has one of the highest market capitalisations per kilowatt of installed capacity in Russia, but is cheap compared to equivalent companies in other countries.
The report gave the price earnings ratio as 28, compared to the 3.5 average for the industry but said the company was well placed to benefit from an expected economic turnaround.

"We believe the Leningrad region local economy will grow beginning in 1997-8, and that Lenenergo will be in a good position to benefit from this growth," the report said, adding current reforms in the power sector would also allow the company to charge other utilities for transporting electricity.
